sections.text:
1 Auctor huius capituli ELEUTHERIUS ZEBELENUS esse videtur, qui in praeceden-
tium titulis nominatur (cf. supra p. 50). Ex computatione quam exempli gratia
praebet, apparet eum die 12 Augusti a. 1040 natum esse et die 18 Decembris
a. 1079 scripsisse.
sections.en:
1 The author of this chapter seems to be ELEUTHERIUS ZEBELENUS, who is named in the titles of the preceding
[chapters] (cf. above p. 50). From the computation which he offers for the sake of example,
it appears that he was born on the 12th day of August in the year 1040 and wrote on the 18th day of December
in the year 1079.

summary.headline: Byzantine Astrological Collections
summary.text: Extracts from Byzantine astrological collections in the Angelicus codex: rules for dignified fortune and quality of action, followed by instructions for calculating the perambulations of stars and places. The discussion names Eleutherius Zebelenus, Ducange, Ptolemy, the Persians, and astrological rulers including the Sun, Moon, Mars, Venus, and Mercury.
